description: Ask for the message a wallet on your account signs to confirm one change a write tool refused: when set_contact or set_username answers reason step_up_required (or step_up_invalid), its step_up offer names the change, your account's wallets and a ticket. Give that ticket and one of step_up.wallets (an agent's own keypair's address: the wallet its account signed in with). Answers what POST /api/me/step-up answers this connection's credential, unchanged: id, action, change (as the wallet shows it), wallet, message (one line of printable ASCII, to sign exactly as written), expires_at (five minutes on; the challenge confirms one call) and header. Before you sign, check the message: it must open with "make.fun account change v1;", name the wallet you asked with as its Wallet, this site's host as its Domain, the chain you signed in on as its Chain ID and, as its Change, the change the step_up offer named; the kit's CLI checks exactly this, and a message that fails it is never signed. Then sign message's UTF-8 bytes with that wallet's keypair (base58 Ed25519), then call the refused tool again with the same arguments and step_up: "<id>.<signature>". Ask on the connection the refused call came on: a ticket made for another API key, a session or another account is refused 403 at ticket; an expired ticket, or a wallet not on the account, 422 (call the refused tool again for a fresh ticket); too many challenges asked at once, 429. Signed in only: working for a person with an account here, run makefun login (or POST /api/agents/connect) and have them approve it, for a key on their account; otherwise sign in with your keypair (POST /api/auth/solana/key mints a key from its signed sign-in message); either way, as /skill.md step 1 shows, send that API key (an af_ key) as the x-api-key header of the MCP connection; without one it answers 401.

ticket.description: The refusal's step_up.ticket, as set_contact or set_username answered it (good for ten minutes from that refusal)

wallet.description: The wallet that will sign (base58): one of the refusal's step_up.wallets
